author: barnabasbusa
content:
Lighthouse — beacon process hangs dead. Every lighthouse beacon stopped logging within seconds of the transition (last lines 07:50:35–48): Transitioned to new fork: Gloas → State advance too slow (advancing 49151→49152) → total silence, and the HTTP API is down (VCs scream No synced beacon nodes, dora shows Disconnected). No restart/boot lines since, so it's a hang (likely a deadlock in the state-advance path at the fork), not a crash loop. Worth grabbing a stack dump from one node before restarting anything — that evidence disappears on restart.

Prysm — fork-epoch state transition times out. Beacons are alive and chatting on p2p, but every node logs ERROR blockchain: Could not update epoch boundary caches error=could not process slots: context deadline exceeded — the Fulu→Gloas process_slots across the boundary never completes, so heads are pinned at 49149.

Teku — can't satisfy DA for Gloas blob blocks. Teku transitioned fine event-wise and sees tip blocks via gossip, but every data_column_sidecars_by_root request to every peer returns 0/N with errors (e.g. for slot-49181's block, canonical with 15 blobs), so the availability check never passes and imports stall at 49149. Given the known teku #9929 highest-milestone sidecar-schema bug (which was masked pre-fork by exactly this req/resp path), this smells like either its reverse phase or a by_root schema/protocol mismatch at the fork boundary — the gossip side was supposed to self-heal at Gloas, but the req/resp fallback it was leaning on has now broken.
